map.输入英文字母与移位量（0–25），工具演示凯撒密码下字母在字母表中的位置偏移结果: Enter English letters and shift amount (0-25); the tool demonstrates the Caesar cipher position offset in the alphabet, for teaching the shift mechanism of classical ciphers.
map.密码学教学：直观展示单表替换与循环移位原理。: Cryptography teaching: intuitively show monoalphabetic substitution and cyclic shift.
map.谜题/游戏：快速生成或破解简单移位密文。: Puzzle/game: quickly generate or crack simple shift ciphers.
map.概念演示：说明密钥空间仅 25 种、极易暴力枚举的弱点。: Concept demo: show the weakness that key space is only 25 and easily brute-forced.
map.：H→K,E→H,L→O,L→O,O→R → \"KHOOR\"；移位 0 或: : H->K, E->H, L->O, L->O, O->R -> "KHOOR"; shift 0 or 26 is plaintext.
map.不安全，密钥空间仅 25 种，穷举即可破解，仅用于教学。: Not secure; key space is only 25 possibilities, easily brute-forced; for teaching only.
map.通常保留空格/标点/数字不变，仅对 A–Z/a–z 循环移位。: Usually keeps spaces/punctuation/digits unchanged, only cyclically shifts A-Z/a-z.
